content: Roll the dice to break the traitorous enemies of Super Earth in this historic crossover Legendary Warbond. Fight for Liberty without measuring distance, line-of-sight or your target’s chances of survival with potent weapons, formidable armor, and so much more. HELLDIVERS™ 2 x WARHAMMER 40,000 Legendary Warbond is available from August 12th 2026 HELLDIVERS™ 2 is Out Now for PS5®, PC & XBOX
chineseContent: 在这款历史性的跨界传奇战争债券中，掷骰子击败超级地球的叛徒敌人。为自由而战，无需测量距离、视线或目标的生存机会，使用强大的武器、强大的装甲等等。 HELLDIVERS™ 2 x WARHAMMER 40,000 Legendary Warbond 将于 2026 年 8 月 12 日发售 HELLDIVERS™ 2 现已推出 PS5®、PC 和 XBOX
